title: The Martini Glass | 2 Miles To BDWY
description:
Stir up some fun in Music City at the Martini Tower.

This brand new 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home is just 2 miles from the heart of Broadway. With a sleek, modern design and a playful martini theme, this space is sure to impress.

Here's what you can expect:
- A fully-equipped kitchen

- A cozy living room perfect for relaxing after a long day of exploring.

- Two bedrooms with comfy beds and private bathrooms.

- A roof top patio where you can enjoy your favorite drink.

The space
On the main floor, you will find an open concept floor plan with the kitchen and living room next to each other. On the main floor there is also a private half bath & a dedicated laundry Room. 

On the second floor, you will find Bedroom 1. Equipped with a Queen bed, A Futon, Smart Tv, Walk in closet with a Pack N Play and a private bathroom. 

On the third floor, you will find Bedroom 2. Equipped with a Queen Bed, 2 Full Beds ( Bunk Bed ) a smart tv, walk in closet and a private bathroom. 

On the 4th and final floor, you will access to your own private roof top patio, and an arcade machine; making this a great place to hang out and catch up with your guests.

Guest access
You'll have full access to the entire unit! All levels and the patio are open to you, but please be aware that parking is limited and first come first serve.

Other things to note
Location Perk: Near Downtown & Major Routes
This newly remodeled building is conveniently located near a major freeway, making it super easy to get around town and explore all that Nashville has to offer. Please note that due to its central location, some traffic noise may be heard, especially during peak hours
